description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or project scope): list the devices in the caller's private mesh and read one by id (GET /api/v1/devices and GET /api/v1/devices/:id) as connect.device@1. Every device belongs to exactly one tenant, so a read never crosses a tenant boundary; a device in another tenant is 404. Posture is the self-reported signal last checked, never a claim the service verifies.
